description: Source code for an asynchronous TCP echo server supporting IPv4 and IPv6, using socket programming and poll for multiplexing.

methods.name: setblocking
methods.description: Sets a socket to blocking or non-blocking mode using fcntl.

methods.name: pollfds_add
methods.description: Adds a file descriptor to the pollfd array for monitoring.

methods.name: pollfds_del
methods.description: Removes a file descriptor from the pollfd array.
